title: What If Your Twin Lived in Space for a Year?
subject: astronaut

scenes.text: What if you stayed on Earth while your identical twin spent a year in space? NASA tried it.
Scott Kelly lived on the space station for about a year. His twin Mark stayed on the ground as the control.
Scientists expected Scott's telomeres, the caps on DNA, to shrink. Instead they grew about 14 percent longer.
Within days of landing they shortened again. Average length returned to normal within six months.
Thousands of genes switched on or off in orbit, with six times more changes in the second half of the mission.
Within six months, over 90 percent of Scott's genes were back to normal. Space changed him, then let go.

description:
What if one identical twin lived in space for a year?
NASA's Twins Study found his telomeres grew longer, then most changes reversed.
